title: Kestrel-9
subtitle: Signal relay station, ice moon Tolla

footer.gm: Referee's map. After the relief pilot's sketch; sizes estimated where the text gives none.
footer.player: Company file copy: Kestrel-9 relay, Tolla

callouts.text: Outer door, iced a hand's width open
Boot prints in the frost lead north
Wall screen: the pulse as a green line
Consoles and relay log: the job
Master breaker: stops the pulse, brings Rask
Hatch behind the rack: crawl to 7
Cable duct to the lab: a tight crawl
Drill pit, 3 m across, 8 m deep
Dr. Maro, frozen in; black glass floor pulses

gm.heading: If they stay too long: d6 every 20 minutes
lines: 1-2  The pulse quickens. Everyone hears it in their teeth.
3  Lights fail in one area for ten minutes.
4  Rask watches from a doorway and withdraws.
5  Frost creeps: one door ices shut (strength test to force).
6  The pit answers the mast: everything loose in 6 slides a hand's width toward it.
Truth: Maro drilled into something that pulses and is dead in the pit. Rask repeats the pulse from the mast, lives in 7 and will not let it be shut down.

player.heading: Company briefing
lines: Kestrel-9: crewed signal relay. Six crew, a mast, a drill.
Eleven weeks ago its carrier changed to a slow, even pulse.
No hail has been answered since.
Recover the relay log. Explain the pulse if you can.
The surface door into the airlock is the way in.
